journey.name: Hardware Wallet Detail Overview
journey.description: Opens the hardware wallet detail screen from the home tile and verifies its overview: the top bar, balance header, the Transfer To Spending entry, which opens the "Transfer Unavailable" sheet since Blocktank channel purchases were removed (synonymdev/bitkit-ios#1097), the grouped activity list, and the Remove device confirm dialog. The final Remove step forgets the device, so run this last (re-run connect-home-tile.xml to pair again). Requires a paired Bridge emulator (run connect-home-tile.xml first).

actions.action: Launch the Bitkit app and go to the wallet home screen
Tap the hardware wallet tile (id "ActivityHardware") beneath the SAVINGS and SPENDING tiles
Verify the hardware wallet detail screen opens (id "HardwareWalletScreen"), showing the device name with a blue bitcoin icon in the top bar and a balance header

If the wallet holds funds, verify the "Transfer To Spending" button (id "HardwareTransferToSpending") is shown, tap it, verify the sheet (id "ChannelsUnavailableSheet") opens with the nav title "Transfer Unavailable", the lightning-bolt image (id "ChannelsUnavailableSheetImage"), the title "MANUAL SETUP REQUIRED" with "MANUAL SETUP" in purple (id "ChannelsUnavailableSheetTitle") and the text "Automatic transfers to your spending balance are no longer available. Use your own node, or set up a connection with another provider." (id "ChannelsUnavailableSheetDescription"), then tap "Cancel" (id "ChannelsUnavailableSheetCancel"); otherwise skip this step
If the activity list shows transactions, verify their circular icons are blue, then tap the first one, verify an activity detail screen opens, and navigate back
Tap the "Remove" button labelled with the device name near the bottom of the screen (id "RemoveHardwareWallet")
Verify a confirm dialog appears (id "RemoveHwWalletDialog") explaining that your funds are safe and your coins won't be deleted
Tap "Cancel" and verify the hardware wallet detail screen is still shown
Tap the "Remove" button labelled with the device name again, then tap "Remove" in the confirm dialog
Verify the app returns to the wallet home screen and no hardware wallet tile is shown
